The data includes: Title, Property Address, Property Type, Landlord, Tenant, Lease Content, Monthly Rent, Security Deposit, Lease Term, Key Terms, Risks, Recommendations, Score, Ai Analysis. Provide insights, recommendations, identify patterns, flag potential issues, and suggest optimizations. Return a structured JSON response with sections for summary, key_metrics, recommendations, and risk_factors.
